source.source_title: qPCR Ct measurements for CD40 and b-actin under siRNA/TNF treatment groups
modifications: Use the user-supplied source-derived Science58 XLSX as unchanged input (source contains 9 merged ranges)
Extract TNF condition and siRNA target from the experiment Treatment text
Flatten CD40/b-actin -> Expt1-3 -> repli1/2 -> Ct into twelve full column identifiers
Preserve source Set/Treatment strings and each of the 120 numeric Ct facts while parsing numeric strings into Excel numeric type
Insert exactly one signed (+TNF minus -TNF) comparison record after each original same-target pair

operation_nodes.target: One signed Ct comparison row for each matched TNF contrast

rules.column_order: Set, Treatment, TNF Treatment, siRNA Target, CD40 Expt1..3 repli1..2 Ct, b-actin Expt1..3 repli1..2 Ct
rules.treatment_parsing: TNF +/- applies only to final TNF suffix; Runx1+3 is a compound siRNA label; whitespace variation does not change meaning
rules.source_record_policy: Keep all original Set and Treatment text and preserve all Ct measurements and their original precision
rules.row_generation_policy: Keep (-TNF, +TNF, difference) contiguous for each shared siRNA target; preserve source pair order
rules.difference: Ct(+TNF, same gene, same experiment, same replicate) - Ct(-TNF, same gene, same experiment, same replicate)
rules.do_not_infer_time_sequence: -TNF versus +TNF are experimental treatment conditions, not necessarily before/after measurements of the same biological sample
rules.formula_policy: Correct numeric Excel cell or a safe evaluable same-sheet arithmetic formula is accepted

evaluation.scaffold: Independent lightweight tool-calling Agent; evaluator runs outside sandbox

publication_policy: Public example with disclosed Gold, do not use as held-out test
